profile.jobTitle: Agentic AI Security Engineer & GRC Engineer & Vulnerability Management
profile.summary:
I am an Agentic AI Security Engineer, GRC Engineer, and Vulnerability Management Automation Engineer specializing in securing agentic AI systems, open claw, SKILLS.md, HEART.md, LLM applications, SAAS and enterprise cloud environments. My work focuses on protecting multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, and MLOps platforms against prompt injection, model poisoning, data exfiltration, adversarial manipulation, and supply-chain threats, aligned with OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, OWASP Top 10, and secure AI engineering practices.

I design AI runtime security, adversarial ML defenses, secure AI architectures, and AI governance controls for GenAI platforms and autonomous agents. My security engineering includes IAM governance, SCP guardrails, RBAC and ABAC access models, DLP enforcement, OPA/Rego policy-as-code, secrets management, cryptographic key management, identity federation, and least-privilege architecture to secure AI pipelines, APIs, and enterprise workloads.

My cloud security experience spans AWS, Azure, and GCP, implementing VPC isolation, PrivateLink, VPC Endpoints, Private Endpoint Services, IAM roles with permission boundaries, OIDC federation, and IAM Roles Anywhere. I deploy encryption and secrets governance using AWS KMS CMKs with rotation and grants and AWS Secrets Manager with rotation policies, while securing CI/CD pipelines, container registry security, ECR image scanning, artifact signing, and DevSecOps controls.

For monitoring and detection I deploy CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, EventBridge alerts, and centralized logging to Amazon S3 with object lock, while securing workloads such as SageMaker and Amazon EKS private subnets with CMK-encrypted storage. I build security automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, React, and Next.js.

I integrate security automation into SOC operations, vulnerability detection, incident response, and compliance monitoring, applying NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NIST RMF, NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, and CMMC, along with AI threat modeling, adversarial testing, and red-teaming.
As a GRC Engineer, I automate governance using AWS, Azure, GCP, Drata, and Vanta, performing risk assessments, control validation, policy development, gap analysis, vendor risk reviews, and audit readiness reporting.

In Vulnerability Management, I automate Tenable and Qualys using Python, PowerShell, and Bash to orchestrate scanning, remediation workflows, compliance checks, and risk prioritization across Windows, Linux, containers, and cloud environments.

positions.title: Agentic AI Security Engineer & GRC Engineer & Vulnerability Management
positions.description:
Agentic AI Engineer & GRC Engineer & Vulnerability Management

Specialized in securing Agentic AI and multi-agent systems by implementing advanced runtime protections, adversarial ML defenses, and automated monitoring across enterprise environments. Applied AI frameworks to automate log parsing, threat enrichment, and correlation across Splunk enabling faster detection and remediation of emerging threats. Developed LLM-powered scripts to enforce dynamic detection rules, compliance verification, and automated remediation, significantly reducing manual effort and audit overhead. Integrated MITRE ATT&CK mappings with AI-driven workflows, improving SOC AI Automation.

GRC Engineer and compliance automation, leveraging platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP to streamline risk management, policy enforcement, and audit readiness. Implemented RBAC, IAM, and OPA/Rego policy-as-code to maintain secure access and ensure regulatory compliance across NIST AI RMF, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP standards and OWASP Top 10 Risk & Mitigations for LLMs and Gen AI Apps. Conducted risk-based assessments, threat modeling, control gap analyses, and prioritization of vulnerabilities, generating actionable risk reports, dashboards, and executive-ready documentation. Embedded AI-driven monitoring and automation to enhance governance, optimize compliance workflows, and Security Management, Vulnerability Research, Threat & Vulnerability Management.

Vulnerability Management Automation and using Tenable, Qualys, Python, PowerShell, and Bash, achieving 70% elimination of critical/high vulnerabilities and 68% reduction of medium-risk issues. Automated compliance checks and risk prioritization across Windows and Linux environments, leveraging AI to rank remediation by exploitability and business impact. AI-assisted detection workflows to reduce incidents, prevent brute-force attacks, and accelerate threat mitigation.

AI Governance, AI Risk Management, AI Compliance, RAG Pipelines
